prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, the camera low on the slick black-and-white tiled floor of a secret 1930s basement speakeasy that is also a mint, between two black iron printing presses with simple faces painted on their sides, one huge and dark in the near foreground, throwing sheets of blank green paper money with no printing on it into the air. Off-centre right, large in frame, a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat with a gold chain, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache dances with his arms flung up as the notes rain down on him, his real-skinned face grinning, eyes shut in bliss. Behind him on a little stage under gold spotlights, a band of gangsters in pinstripe suits plays trumpet, double bass and drums; scarlet velvet curtains. Emerald lamps hang over the presses. Most of the frame in warm shadow; the brightest values are the gold spots, the flying notes catching the emerald light and the spilled champagne on the tiles. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
